faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
faq.q1: How does the AI learn my website content?
faq.a1: IntelliConvo automatically crawls your website pages and converts all text content into vector embeddings stored in our database. The AI uses semantic search to find the most relevant content when answering visitor questions — no manual training, no data exports, no setup complexity.
faq.q2: How long does the setup actually take?
faq.a2: Under 5 minutes — often less. You enter your URL, our crawler maps your pages, you select which ones to include, we generate your embed code, and you paste one line of JavaScript into your website. That's it. Your AI goes live immediately.
faq.q3: Do I need any technical or coding skills?
faq.a3: None at all. If you (or your developer) can paste one line of code into your website, IntelliConvo handles everything else — crawling, embedding, hosting, and serving answers. No machine learning knowledge required.
faq.q4: What is human handoff and how does it work?
faq.a4: Human handoff is the bridge between AI automation and live support. When the AI detects that a visitor needs human help, it automatically routes the conversation to your agent dashboard in real-time. Your agents see the full conversation history before joining, so they can jump in with full context — no awkward catch-up.
faq.q5: Can I customize how the chat widget looks on my website?
faq.a5: Yes, extensively. There are 70+ customization options: colors, fonts, button position and size, welcome messages, AI persona and tone, accessibility settings, inline vs. floating modes, and more. Your widget can perfectly match your brand identity.
faq.a6: IntelliConvo automatically detects and responds in the language your visitor writes in — no configuration needed. It supports 50+ languages including English, French, Spanish, German, Arabic, Japanese, Portuguese, and more.
faq.q7: Is my data and my visitors' data secure?
faq.a7: Absolutely. All data is encrypted in transit (TLS/HTTPS) and at rest (AES-256). We are fully GDPR compliant. You own your data and can delete everything at any time from your dashboard. Visitor conversations are never used to train models.
faq.q8: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
faq.a8: Yes, anytime — no questions asked, no cancellation fees. You can cancel directly from your account dashboard. Your AI assistant will continue working until the end of your current billing period.
